title: magnen77's Weaponery
description: This datapack adds fully customizable firearms. Currently, five firearms and their corresponding ammunition types have been added to the game, along with a "The Armory Table"—a crafting station for weapons.
body:
## ✨Recipes
![.308 Large-caliber](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/835f1f8b02289e44ca815255bab9c47ddfb36fde.png)
![.7x62 Medium-caliber](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ace2dcc85ebe4eb44309da1ac628cafc9572e25.png)

![The Armory Table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fd13ea0473e373c3f7087df73dd21e241b2454d.png)

## ⚙️Additional information
- The datapack includes two localizations: **English** (en_us) and **Russian** (ru_ru).
- Weapons can be customized by editing the files located in the following directory: mgn_w/function/main/settings/<Weapon Name>
Afterward, type `/reload` in the chat.
